chapter.verse: “Note na pukkhak loh nadingun hih thute kong gen khinzo hi.
Mite in vengkhawm innte pan hong hawlkhia ding uh hi. Note hong that peuhpeuh in Pasian' kiangah biakpiakna a bawl danin a kingaihsut uh hunlenai hong tung ta ding hi.
Amaute in ka Pa ahi-a kei ka hi zongin hong thei lo uh ahih manin hih thute bawl ding uh hi.

Ahi zongin amau' hunlenai hong tun ciangin amau' vai hong gen khin ka hihlam na phawkkik theih nadingun hih thute hong gen ka hi hi. “A kipat pan note tawh hong omkhawm ka hih manin hih thute kong gen kei hi.
Tu-in ahihleh kei hong sawlpa' kiangah ka va pai ta ding hi. Note khat mahmah in zong, ‘Koi ah va pai ding na hi hiam?’ ci-in nong dong kei uh hi.
Ahi zongin hih thute hong gen khinzo ka hih manin na lungsim uh dahna tawh kidim ta hi.

Himah taleh maantak kong cihin ah kei ka va pai pen note' hamphat nading ahi hi. A hang pen kei va pai kei le-ing note' kiangah Huhpa hong pai lo ding hi. Ahi zongin kei va pai le-ing note' kiangah amah kong sawl ding hi.
Amah hong tun ciangin leitung mite' tungah mawhna thu, dikna thu leh thukhenna thu laktel ding hi.
Mawhna thu cih ciangin kei hong up loh man uh, leh
dikna thu cihna ah Pa' kiangah va pai le-ing kei hong mu nawnlo ding na hih man uh hi a,
thukhenna thu ahihleh hih leitung-uk mangpa' tungah thu kikhen ta ahih man, ahi hi.
“Kong gen ding thu tampi om lai a, ahi zongin tu tadih tuate na sang zo kei ding uh hi.

Thumaan thutak Kha hong tun ciangin amah in thumaan thutak khempeuh note hong hilh ding hi. A hang pen ama' ut thu tawh hong gen ding hilo a, a zak peuhpeuh hong genkhia ding hizaw hi. Hong tung ding thute zong note' kiangah hong tangko ding hi.
Amah in keima' minpha la-in note' kiangah hong tangko ding ahih manin ka min hong sangkhan ding ahi hi.
Keima' minpha la-in note' kiangah hong tangko ding ka cihna pen Pa' neih khempeuh keima' a ahih man ahi hi.
“Tawmvei khit ciangin kei nong mu nawnkei ding uh a, tawmvei khit leuleu ciangin kei nong mu ding uh hi.”

Hih bang a gen ciangin ama' nungzuite kimkhat khatlekhat kiho uh a, “Ei' tunga hong thugen, ‘Tawmvei khit ciangin kei nong mu nawnkei ding uh a, tawmvei khit leuleu ciangin kei nong mu ding uh hi,’ a cih thu leh, ‘a hang pen Pa' kiangah a va pai ding ka hi,’ a cih thu, bang a cihnopna hiding hiam?” ci uh hi.
Tua hangin amaute in, “A thugenna ah ‘tawmvei khit’ a cih pen bang ahi ding hiam? Ama' cihnop i thei kei hi,” ci phapha uh hi.

Jesu in ama' kiangah thu dong nuam uh ahihlam thei ahih manin hih bangin gen hi: “Note khatlekhat na kidot uh, ‘Tawmvei khit ciangin kei nong mu nawnkei ding uh a, tawmvei khit leuleu ciangin kei nong mu ding uh hi,’ ka cih pen ahi hiam?
Maantak diktak kong cihin ah note kapin na thum ding uh a, ahi zongin leitung mite lungdam ding uh hi. Note na lunggim ding uh a, ahi zongin na lunggimna uh nuamna suak ding hi.
Numei khat nau a suah ciangin ama' hunlenai tung ta ahih manin gimna thuak a, ahi zongin nau a suah khit ciangin mihing khat leitung ah hong suak khinta cih nuamna hangin gimna teng phawk nawnlo hi.
Tua mah bangin note zong tu-in lunggimna na thuak uh a, ahi zongin note hong vankik ding ka hih manin lungsim sungah na lungdam ding uh hi. Tua na nuamna uh kuamah in hong lakkhiatsak zolo ding hi.
Tua ni ciangin kei' kiangah bangmah nong ngen kei ding uh hi. Maantak diktak kong cihin ah keima' min suangin Pa' kiangah na nget peuhpeuh uh amah in hong pia ding hi.
Tu ciangciang keima' min suangin bangmah na ngen naikei uh hi. Ngen un, na ngah ding uh hi. Tua pen na nuamna uh a kicin nading ahi hi.
“Hih thute etsakna thutom tawh kong gen khinzo hi. Etsakna thutom tawh hilo-in a sialpi-in Pa' thu kong gen ding hunlenai hong tung ta hi.
Tua ni ciangin keima' min suangin thu na ngen ding uh hi. Pa' kiangah note' taangin ke'n thungen ding kong ci kei hi.
A hang pen note in kei nong it uh a, Pasian' kiangpan hong pai ka hihlam hong um na hih manun Pa mahmah in note hong it hi.
Kei pen Pa' kiangpan kuankhia-in leitung hong pai ka hi a, tu-in leitung nusia-in Pa' kiangah a zuankik ta ding ka hi hi.”
Tua ciangin a nungzuite in, “En in, tu-in etsakna thutom zang lo-in thu a sialpi-in nong gen hi.
Nangmah in na khempeuh na thei a, hong kidot phot ding zong kisam lo na hihlam ka thei uh hi. Hih thu hangin zong Pasian' kiangpan hong kuankhia na hihlam hong um ka hi uh hi,” ci uh hi.
Jesu in hih bangin dawng hi: “Tu-in um na hi uh hiam?

En un, note kithehthangin na inn tek uhah ciahin kei kia nong nusiat ding uh hunlenai hong tung kuanta a, zong hong tung takpi ta hi. Himah taleh Pa pen kei tawh hong omkhawm ahih manin kei kia ka hikei hi.
Keima' sungah lungnopna na neih theih nadingun hih thute kong gen hi. Leitung ah gimna na thuak ding uh a, ahih hangin lungnuamin om un—keimah in leitung ka zo khinzo hi.”
